en: A vintage black-and-white postcard image showing a snowy alpine landscape. Several skiers are walking or skiing toward a rustic wooden hut. Skilifts and snow-covered coniferous trees are visible. The background features dramatic, high mountains with heavy snow cover, giving a classic European alpine winter scene. The right side of the image is faded, possibly for text, but appears to be blank.
